items.q: took a music major there under a very talented man named Tergee Debolis ... an excellent classical pianist and a master of harmony, and really knew how to teach the students

ctx.x: Uh huh. So we know you've been at Tuskegee and then Talladega and all this. Now when did you first start to go and make gigs and do a little playing? What kind of groups did you go out with?

That would have been in Detroit late in the year, 1929. I went to college one year in Talladega, took a music major there under a very talented man named Tergee Debolis (phonetic) -- an excellent classical pianist and a master of harmony, and really knew how to teach the students the basic things that we really should know about music.
